description: Unambiguous, single source-of-truth mapping between conceptual geographic scopes, internal engine enums, database persistence representations, public consumer API representations, and benchmark evaluation classes.
backwardCompatibilityGuarantee: Public API preserves location_scope as a string DTO field compatible with OpenAPI contract. No client breakage.

taxonomyMatrix.definition: Digital transaction executed on a website, mobile application, or digital portal. No physical presence required.
taxonomyMatrix.consumerExperience: Displayed with "Online Only" badge. Strictly excluded from Nearby map view and distance filters.

taxonomyMatrix.definition: Single concrete physical establishment explicitly named with venue name or street address in source evidence.
taxonomyMatrix.consumerExperience: Pin placed at verified venue coordinates. Eligible for Nearby radial distance search.

taxonomyMatrix.definition: Multiple specific branches/venues enumerated in the bank source evidence.
taxonomyMatrix.consumerExperience: Multiple pins placed at each verified branch location. Included in Nearby search for all participating branches.

taxonomyMatrix.definition: Offer is explicitly restricted to selected merchant outlets, but the bank source omits or fails to enumerate the complete branch list.
taxonomyMatrix.consumerExperience: Displayed with "Selected Outlets Only — Check Terms" notice. Suppressed from map pins to prevent false attendance.

taxonomyMatrix.definition: Offer is restricted to a specific administrative district, province, or suburban cluster (e.g. "Selected Colombo outlets") without exact street addresses.
taxonomyMatrix.consumerExperience: Searchable via area/district filters (e.g. Colombo). Zero false centroid pins on map.

taxonomyMatrix.definition: Offer explicitly applies across all merchant outlets islandwide or has no outlet restriction.
taxonomyMatrix.consumerExperience: Displayed with "All Outlets / Islandwide" badge. Excluded from strict radial map pins; included when consumer selects "Include Nationwide".

taxonomyMatrix.definition: Source evidence contains insufficient geographic data to establish branch applicability or restriction.
taxonomyMatrix.consumerExperience: Suppressed from map pins. Flagged in admin review console. Preserves consumer safety through conservative abstention.

branchCompletenessDefinitions.ALL_OUTLETS_APPLICABLE: Source explicitly states all outlets participate, or the promotion is inherently islandwide/digital.
branchCompletenessDefinitions.COMPLETE_BRANCH_LIST: Source enumerates all participating branches with names or addresses.
branchCompletenessDefinitions.INCOMPLETE_RESTRICTION: Source asserts an outlet restriction (e.g. "selected outlets only"), but omits the complete list.
branchCompletenessDefinitions.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Source contains no geographic or branch information.
